column3: {text_effect:4}Oooh...{pause_20_skippable} Help me...{end_wait}
Grandpa!{pause_20_skippable} Grandpa!\nStay with me!{end_wait}
Oh, no!{pause_20_skippable} Not again!{end_wait}
Get {actor_name:4}...{pause_20_skippable}\nPlease, get {actor_name:4}!{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}It hurts...{end_wait}
Get {actor_name:4}... Hurry!{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Oooh...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable} I don't feel well\n{pause_20_skippable}... Am I going to die?{end_wait}
Her palms shine with\na blue light...\nIs she{pause_20_skippable} an angel?{end_wait}
The shop is closed\nuntil we're well.{end_wait}
Do you want weapons?{end_now}
I can't sell weapons\nuntil I'm cured. {text_effect:4}Ohh...{pause_20_skippable}{reset_text_style}\nChills... {text_effect:4}Cough!{reset_text_style}{end_wait}

Travelers from the
south brought this
sickness to our village.{page_break}{reset_text_style}Are you from the south,
too? If you have no
business here,{page_break}then leave... {text_effect:4}Cough!{reset_text_style}{end_wait}
I'm sorry. I can't\nopen the shop today.{end_wait}
We're closed for now.{page_break}I didn't mean to shout.\nIt's been a hard week.{end_wait}
Why must everyone\ncome when I'm ill?{end_wait}
Mother is sick.{page_break}Tell me what you need.\nI'll find it.{end_wait}
Father went south\nto work in Kolima.{page_break}We haven't heard\nfrom him since.{end_wait}
My daughter can help\nyou with your order.{end_wait}
If the old spring\nstill flowed...{page_break}Perhaps it could\nhelp the sick.{end_wait}
We're open all winter.{page_break}There aren't many guests.\nYou're welcome to stay.{end_wait}
Do you want to see\nthe restaurant menu?{end_now}
Here you go.{pause_20_skippable} We're small,\nso the selection isn't\ngreat.{end_wait}
Stew and rye bread.{page_break}It's not much,\nbut it'll warm you.{end_wait}
We've had more guests\nthan usual this week.{page_break}I wish they'd come\nunder better skies.{end_wait}
Winter keeps us inside.{page_break}It's good to hear\na new voice.{end_wait}
A hot meal sounds\nlike a feast right now.{end_wait}
Looking for {actor_name:4}?{end_now}
{actor_name:4} just left.{page_break}The sick need {actor_name:4}\nmore than ever.{end_wait}
Have you visited the\nold couple near the\nentrance of town?{end_now}
Oh. That's where\n{actor_name:4} was going.{page_break}You may have\njust missed her.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} went there.{page_break}You may have missed her.{end_wait}
How do you feel now?{end_wait}
{text_effect:4} Cough...{pause_20_skippable} Cough...{end_wait}
He's been coughing\nfor days.{end_wait}
Rest. You'll be\nstronger soon.{end_wait}

{text_effect:4}Cough{pause_20_skippable} cough...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nCough{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}... {pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nCough... {pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}Cough...{end_wait}
Any better, Grandpa?{end_wait}
A little... yes.{end_wait}
Don't try to stand yet.\nPlease, Grandpa.{end_wait}
Thank you, {actor_name:4}...{page_break}I don't know how this\nvillage would survive\nwithout you...{page_break}{text_effect:4}Cough{reset_text_style}...{end_wait}
Don't thank me yet.{page_break}You need rest too.{end_wait}
Who are you?{end_wait}
Can I help you?{end_wait}
Was that...\nthe lighthouse?{end_wait}
No. It can't be.{end_wait}
Only I can enter...{end_wait}
Alex! What have you done?{end_wait}
I feel much better,\nthanks to {actor_name:4}.\nI should be fine now.{end_wait}
What happened\nat the lighthouse?{end_wait}
Even if {actor_name:4} heals us,\nthe sickness comes back\nevery winter. {text_effect:4}Brr...{end_wait}
How can anyone run\nin weather like this?{end_wait}
I'm tending the sick\nwhile {actor_name:4} is away.{end_wait}
I can change bandages.\nThe rest will take\nmore practice.{end_wait}
Everyone depends\non {actor_name:4}.{end_wait}
We have to help {actor_name:4}.\nShe can't do it alone.{end_wait}
Fountain of Healing{page_break}Water of Hermes:\nIt brings rejuvenation\nto all that lives.{end_wait}
Someone's inside.{end_wait}
I hear someone...{end_wait}
Can you hear it, too?{end_now}
Only Alex and I\ncan enter this tower.{end_wait}
You don't hear it?{page_break}Only Alex and I\ncan enter this tower.{end_wait}
The statue blocks\nthe passage.{end_wait}
The statue won't move.{end_wait}
Someone wants to keep\nme out. They won't.{end_wait}
Did you do that?{end_now}
You{pause_20_skippable}...{pause_20_skippable} You could\nsee our Psynergy?{end_wait}
We thought you used\nPsynergy when you healed\nthat old man, {actor_name:4}.{end_wait}
It was once\nmuch stronger...{end_wait}
The Mercury Clan sounds\nlike the people of Vale.\nDon't you think?{end_now}
Sure... They guard a\nspecial power, just\nlike us.{end_wait}

Oh, come on! Both are
protectors of a special
power.{page_break}Only the names are
different.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4} used Ply.{end_wait}
A monster? Here?\nInside the lighthouse?{end_wait}
I have to get past it.{end_wait}
It's blocked again.{page_break}There must be\nanother way.{end_wait}
This statue was moved.{page_break}Alex... why?{end_wait}
You helped me again.\nThank you.{end_wait}
Good. Then let's move.{end_wait}
The Adept {actor_name:4} joined\nyour party!{end_wait}
The beacon's lit!\nWe're too late!{end_wait}
No...{end_wait}
The Mercury Star\nshould be required.\nHow did they...?{end_wait}
The Stars were stolen\nfrom Sol Sanctum,\non Mt. Aleph.{end_wait}
Mt. Aleph...{pause_20_skippable}\nAre you healers\nfrom Sol Sanctum?{end_now}
We're from Vale.\nWe came to get\nthose Stars back.{end_wait}
But we're not healers.\nNot like you.{end_wait}
We're from Mt. Aleph.\nBut we're not healers.{end_wait}
We came from Vale\nto reclaim the\nElemental Stars.{end_wait}
Did you say{pause_20_skippable} Vale?{end_wait}
Our village guarded\nSol Sanctum.\nThey stole the Stars.{end_wait}
Then your village\nhad a duty like mine.{end_wait}
And I failed mine...{pause_20_skippable}{page_break}I couldn't stop them.{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! {actor_name:2}!{end_wait}
So it's you, {actor_name:1}!{end_wait}
We're bringing\nour friends home!\nAnd taking the Stars!{end_wait}
Then you know\nwhy we can't let\nyou stop us.{end_wait}
They'll never stop\nfollowing us.\nWe end this here.{end_wait}
Menardi...{pause_20_skippable} Enough.{end_wait}
Saturos, they know\nwhat we've taken...{end_wait}
I know.{end_wait}
They survived\nMt. Aleph's collapse.\nNo small feat.{end_wait}
You survived\nMt. Aleph. Don't\nthrow your lives away.{end_wait}
Turn back now.\nI won't ask again.{end_wait}
You'll face them\nalone, Saturos?{end_wait}
Take the hostages.\nGo to the next beacon.\nI'll hold them here.{end_wait}
Understood.{end_wait}
I want to see\nhow far they've come\nsince we last met.{end_wait}
Saturos, the beacon...\nIt's weakening you.{end_wait}
I know.{pause_20_skippable} Go.\nLight the next beacon.\nDon't wait for me.{end_wait}
Come here, child.{end_wait}
You'll defy me\neven now?{end_wait}
Don't make me\ndrag you along.{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}, talk to her.\nI won't ask again.{end_wait}
{actor_name:6}{pause_20_skippable}, please...\nDo as she says\nfor now.{end_wait}
{actor_name:5}{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{pause_20_skippable}.{end_wait}
It's all right, {actor_name:6}.{end_wait}
Why did {actor_name:1} and\n{actor_name:2} follow us?\nThey could be killed.{end_wait}
I'm sorry, {actor_name:1},\n{actor_name:2}...{end_wait}
Everyone, on the lift!\nNow!{end_wait}
{actor_name:1}! {actor_name:2}!\nDon't{pause_20_skippable} die!{end_wait}
{actor_name:6}... \nKraden!{end_wait}
If you want them alive,\nyou'll have to go\nthrough me.{end_wait}
Wait!\nDon't rush him!{end_wait}
What's wrong?\nHave you lost\nyour nerve?{end_wait}
His power is immense.\nI felt it when\nwe faced him before.{end_wait}
Don't fight him\non his terms.{page_break}Watch his movements.\nWait for an opening.{end_wait}
Then you've yet\nto see my strength.{end_wait}
He's wavering...\nSomething's wrong.{end_wait}
That light... The\nMercury beacon is\ndraining my strength!{end_wait}
